name: 采购计划与产品货源确定集成 (6AJ)
name_en: Procurement Planning Integration with Product Sourcing (6AJ)
description_en_html:
Overview

In SAP Ariba Procurement Planning, the project manager plans procurement projects and the purchaser bundles all items to be sourced. The project manager then transfers the bundles to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for product sourcing, where the sourcing manager maintains the automatically created sourcing projects. If there are changes on item data, the purchaser sends the updates to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for product sourcing. Once the sourcing manager enters all relevant information and publishes the sourcing project, SAP Ariba Procurement Planning is automatically notified about the relevant deadlines and timelines. In addition, the external supplier platform connected to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for product sourcing automatically receives information on the newly published sourcing project. Supplier quotations are created, submitted and sent back to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for product sourcing, where they are eventually awarded. After that, follow-on documents are created.

Key Process Flow

  • Procurement Project Planning
  • Bundling
  • Sourcing Project Processing

Business Benefits

  • Gain full control on parts and flexibility in bundling them to structure the sourcing process
  • Use an efficient process to initiate multiple sourcing projects out of procurement plan
  • Gain visibility on the progress of the end-to-end sourcing projects in the plan
  • Forward sourcing capabilities with multi-round supplier negotiations to ensure best results
description_zh_html:
概览

在 SAP Ariba Procurement Planning 中，项目经理计划采购项目，采购员捆绑所有待寻源的项目。项目经理然后将捆绑包传输到面向产品寻源的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition，寻源经理在其中维护自动创建的货源确定项目。如果项目数据发生更改，采购员会将更新发送到面向产品寻源的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition。寻源经理输入所有相关信息并发布寻源项目后，会自动通知 SAP Ariba Procurement Planning 相关截止日期和时间表。此外，连接到面向产品寻源的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 的外部供应商平台会自动接收有关新发布的寻源项目的信息。创建、提交供应商报价并将其发送回面向产品寻源的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition，最终在其中授标。之后，将创建后续凭证。

关键流程流

  • 采购项目计划
  • 捆绑
  • 货源确定项目处理

业务优势

  • 全面控制部件，灵活捆绑部件，构建寻源流程
  • 使用有效的流程，根据采购计划启动多个货源确定项目
  • 了解计划中端到端寻源项目的进度。
  • 通过多轮供应商谈判提供正向寻源功能，以确保获得最佳结果
